title: The Flashback — Inheritance by Witness
trigger: after mission two (The Traverse Door) is sealed. story_progress 1 -> 2. The master gate opens: Zero gains the ability to wield keyblades.
scene: The Door seals. And in the closing of it, Zero is somewhere else.
A shore. A scrap of an island before the worlds fell. The waves are clean, and the sky is not falling.
Two boys sit in the mouth of a cave, drawing in the sand with a stick. The smaller one — yellow shorts, brown spikes of hair — scratches a shape over and over: a key.
This time I'll draw the Keyblade, he says. And the older one laughs, because the key is always crooked.
Zero watches from the wobble of a door that is not there. The Motes rise from the sand like breath. The failed Inheritances of a hundred unfinished forges lean toward the drawing.
The boy finishes. It is crooked. It is enough.
'Little witnesses,' the shadow he wears says, in a voice that is Zero's own. 'He does not know what he has drawn.'
But Zero knows. Every lost Inheritance in the world can feel it: that drawing, in the sand of a drowning island, is the first keyblade that will ever be chosen rather than forged.
The red sabres at Zero's hips flare — once, together, like a held breath letting go. The Inheritance lands. It was never a thing to be given. It was a thing to be seen.
A keyblade answers at his side: Dusk-colored metal, the weight of both halves of something that refused to be cut. The Twilight Keyblade.

reward.note: From this moment Zero may wield keyblades in game. The twin red sabres remain in his loadout as the fast, honest steel of his first act.
